ModMetaData.name: Homesteader
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Everything a growing homestead needs: tribal survival, farm-to-table crafting, wells and irrigation, storage, food preservation, and off-grid power.
TRIBAL SURVIVAL (no research) - Drying rack: jerky, dried produce, fruit leather, dried mushrooms, and pemmican without needing pemmican research. - Field crops, basic storage crates, barrels, and pallets.
PRIMITIVE HOMESTEAD - Curing rack and smokehouse for salted and smoked meat. - Hayloft and ingredient barrel for bulk farm storage. - Orchard trees (apple, cherry, sugar maple).
FARMSTEAD CRAFTING - Grain mill, butter churn, cheese press, pickling crock, and homestead hearth. - Dairy pipeline: skim cream → churn butter (+ buttermilk) or press cheese; wax or smoke cheese. - Sugar, honey, or maple syrup for jam, porridge, and cider; butter for bread and flapjacks. - Pantry meals: toast and jam, ploughman's lunch, honey porridge, pumpkin pie, buttermilk biscuits. - Cider vinegar, vinegar pickles, apple cider, and homestead soap. - Favorite food mood for every humanlike (Homesteader + vanilla pool); maypole harvest cheer.
WATER & IRRIGATION - Hand-dug well, rain barrel, cistern, solar still, and stone fountain (wellcraft research). - Deep well and water tower (waterworks research). - Irrigated soil and irrigated planter (+30% fertility) (irrigation research). - Boiled water, mud bricks, and clean bandages crafted from water. - Optional Dubs Bad Hygiene: rain barrel / cistern / water tower store plumbing water; hand-dug well acts as a primitive groundwater source; deep well is a piped deep inlet. Jug water for irrigation still works.
ORCHARD & APIARY - Apple and cherry trees: slow-growing, regrowing orchard fruit for cider, jam, and eating fresh. - Sugar maple: tap for maple sap and boil it into maple syrup at the hearth - then griddle flapjacks. - Beehives produce beeswax alongside honey; render it into slow-burning beeswax candles.
AROUND THE FARMHOUSE - Preserves shelf: beautiful display storage for jams, pickles, cheese, dairy, honey, and syrup. - Nesting box: a snug straw-lined bed for small animals. - Harvest maypole: a ribboned gathering spot colonists celebrate around. - Polyarmory trait: polycule members (lovers and metamours with the trait) are fine sharing multi-person beds (works with Polyamory Beds).
LIVESTOCK, FIBER & PANTRY - Chicken coop (eggs); animal mash from barley, pumpkin, or hay. - Render lard/tallow and stuff sausage from cured meats and herbs. - Flax crop, spinning wheel, loom, and homestead quilts (quilted beds need a quilt). - Compost heap → fertilizer → composted soil (+45% fertility). - Icehouse (≤0°C) and springhouse (≤8°C) passive cold storage. - Canning kitchen (mason jars, canned stew/jam), cider press (apple juice → cider), wash tub (soap scrub).
RESEARCH & PROGRESSION - Primitive homestead, food preservation, farmstead crafting, homestead storage, brewing, comforts, and advanced homestead. - Livestock, textiles, soil and cold storage, pantry craft. - Wellcraft → irrigation / waterworks. - Root cellar (passive cool storage ≤5°C), large storage crate, jam cauldron, and wood-burning generator.
STORYTELLER - Azrael: Cassandra-style pacing with a bit more Misc / ThreatSmall for series flavor (Living World, Stormproof, homestead life). Canonical copy ships here; the optional Azrael showcase mod adds The Deep Homestead scenario.
POWER - Compact battery, battery bank, advanced battery, ultratech battery, portable chemfuel generator.
Odyssey owners get salted and smoked fish recipes automatically.
Requires the Harmony mod (C# for root cellar cooling and favorite foods). Safe to add to a save. Before removing it, deconstruct the mod's buildings and use up or sell its items.
Note: former Wellspring water content now ships inside Homesteader (Wellspring_* defNames preserved). Disable any old standalone Wellspring mod.
Optional: Dubs Bad Hygiene soft-compat patches Homesteader water buildings into its plumbing when that mod is present.
